required_repairs_before_preregistration: Add explicit verifier-coverage tests (oracle/unit tasks) that enumerate which property-classes the verifier fully supports and document verifier limitations per property class.
Document emulator fidelity limits and scope; include at least one vendor-like behavioral test or clearly state out-of-scope vendor semantics (rollback/CLI differences) in the preregistration.

Prespecify and freeze retry policy, exact random seeds, API/model version identifiers, logging/recording of nondeterministic runs, and how retries for infrastructure failures differ from scientific retries.

Either include a small multi-model robustness check (e.g., one additional hosted or local smaller model) or provide a preregistered justification for a single-model design and specify how generalizability will be qualified in threats-to-validity.
